usage: icebath prompt-size [-h] [--platform PLATFORM] [--json]

Report the fixed prompt budget for a fresh session: system prompt total, skills index, memory,
user profile, and tool-schema JSON. Runs offline (no API call).

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --platform PLATFORM  Platform to simulate (cli, telegram, discord, ...). Default: cli
  --json               Emit the breakdown as JSON
